lines.text: The beloved should not be surprised at the fiery trial, but rejoice that they share in Christ's sufferings.
Those insulted for the name of Christ are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on them.
None of them should suffer as a murderer or adulterer or wrongdoer, or even as a meddler.
Believers who suffer as Christians should not be afraid, because judgment begins with the family of God.
Those who suffer according to God's will should entrust their souls to their faithful Creator and continue to do good.
